name: Liam O'Connor
psychographics: Pragmatic and frugal; values control over his schedule and dislikes feeling rushed at mealtimes.
current_solutions: Meal prepping on Sundays using recipes from the BBC Good Food app; uses a Tesco Grocery Pass for weekly basics.
frustration: Last Tuesday at 6:30pm, he opened Deliveroo to find the minimum order was £25 and his cart was only £18, so he had to abandon it and cook stale pasta instead.
decision_style: Compares unit prices on the shelf; buys store brand if the difference is under 10p.
voice: Blunt and practical; often says 'I just need it to work' when a app glitches.
